component.name: Compositor
component.summary: A free, open-source, Photoshop-style image editor

description.p: Compositor is a full-featured image editor that is completely free and open source. It is built around a Photoshop-style compositing and post-processing workflow, with layers, masks, adjustment layers, transform, selections, painting and retouching tools, and a full set of adjustments and filters.
This is the Linux port: a Qt Widgets shell over a retained Swift core, with Skia compositing and OpenCV named operations, packaged as a Flatpak.
Signed Flatpak updates, Linux release downloads, and faster Gaussian and Motion Blur rendering.

First Linux Flatpak preview build of the port. Feature-aligned with macOS 1.0.4; not yet at full parity. Packages the portable C pixel kernels behind a Qt Widgets host shell with a Swift core on a C ABI.
